title: Manual check in the DAW: a collection's clip files and drum rack
description:
## Intent

Check the collection export in the DAW.

## Steps (owner)

1. Keep a handful of candidates into a collection in the curation loop (some loops, some shots).
2. `apricity export --clips --collection <name> --library ~/Apricity-Library -o ~/Music/Apricity-collections`.
3. In the DAW's browser: the files show in collection order; previews play in time; a loop dragged onto a track sits on the grid.
4. Drag `<name>.adg` onto a MIDI track: one pad per short item, in order from C1, levels even; play them against `apricity play` of a score using the same clips as a drum kit.

## Verification

A comment with the DAW version and pass/fail per step; failures filed as bugs under this epic.

## Release

No commit.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the CLI task in this epic.
